top_macro_signals: SEBI and RBI tightening risk architectures while accelerating instant digital rails (Account Aggregator, vKYC).
Retail FinTechs pivoting rapidly from pure discounted broking to high-yield MTF and advisory cross-sell lines.
Automated self-serve servicing (>80%) and lower cost-to-serve emerging as the defining drivers of P&L resilience.

briefing_cards.headline: Diwali Muhurat Trading 2026, Samvat 2083: Date, timings, history, settlement rules, more - Top 10 things for investors
briefing_cards.summary: India’s exchanges will hold Diwali Muhurat Trading on Sunday, November 8, marking the start of Samvat 2083. The main equity session runs from 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm, with separate windows for pre-open orders, commodities, IPOs and other securities.
